title: A schedule name cannot be blank or already in use
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as an Owner/Admin or as a user with "Settings Service" enabled.
  2. In the left sidebar under Settings, open the "Maintenance" entry beneath "Inspection Templates" (if the build shows "Maintenance schedules" instead, use that entry and record the label). Schedules are shared by the whole organization, whichever location is chosen in the header.
  3. Seed a maintenance schedule (standard steps):
  4. ↳ In Settings > Maintenance click New schedule; the "Untitled schedule" editor opens.
  5. ↳ Inline-edit the title to a test name (e.g. "Highway Tractor PM").
  6. ↳ Click Add service, give it a name (e.g. "PM-A") and a calendar interval (e.g. Every 3 months), and save the service.
  7. ↳ Click Save on the schedule.
  8. A second schedule named "Old Tractor PM" exists and is archived (row menu > Archive).
custom_steps:
1. Click New schedule, add one service, clear the title so it is blank, and click Save.
  2. On an existing schedule, inline-rename the title to blank and click away.
  3. Click New schedule, name it "Highway Tractor PM" (the name already in use), add one service and click Save.
  4. Change the name to "Old Tractor PM" (the archived schedule's name) and click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The blank title reverts to the previous name ("Untitled schedule" for a new one); no error is shown.
  • The blank inline rename reverts to the previous name; no error is shown.
  • Save is refused with the message "A schedule with this name already exists." shown inline under the name.
  • The archived schedule's name is refused the same way.
  • On the design the validation note reads "Blank on blur reverts to the previous name. Same for rename."

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10558 (S1, Create a maintenance schedule), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S1 (The editor; S1-N3, S1-E2); Plan 1 — Track, act, clear — Technical Implementation Plan, section 1, requirement table row S1-E2; Design board "Chunk 1.dc.html" (MR V2 Claude Design project, version of 6 October 2026), artboard V1; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-N3: “A schedule cannot be saved with a blank name, and an inline rename cannot be left blank. Both revert to the previous name rather than erroring”
  • S1-N3: “an inline rename cannot be left blank. Both revert to the previous name rather than erroring”
  • S1-E2: “Two schedules cannot have the same name, as with inspection templates. A name already in use is refused inline: A schedule with this name already exists.”
  • Plan 1 §1 S1-E2: “Names unique across the organization (archived included); duplicate named (Copy), (Copy 2)”
  • Design board, artboard V1 (validation): “Blank on blur reverts to the previous name. Same for rename.”
